hook.en: Can a simple smile be weighed on the Day of Judgment?

hadith.en: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face. Reported by Muslim.

explain1.en: Shaykh Ibn Uthaymeen, may Allah have mercy on him, explained: Meeting others with warmth brings peace to hearts and removes hatred. It costs you nothing, yet Allah writes it as an act of charity.

explain2.en: And Shaykh Ibn Baz explained: Never look down upon any righteous deed. A gentle word or an open face can be the reason Allah forgives your sins and elevates your status.

close.en: Share it, and may Allah accept your deeds.
